diagnosis: Reusable workflow_call declared credentials required at caller scope, but deployment supplies them only in hpc Environment jobs. The credential-free result job failed before starting a runner.
repair: Caller secrets are optional in software-pair and md-pair; hpc execution jobs explicitly require both resolved credentials before preparing an SSH key. Result jobs need no hpc environment.
